title: Core: Onion skinning frame range calculation
description: Unit tests for onion skinning frame range utilities. Given currentFrame=5 and onionSkinBefore=2, onionSkinAfter=2, the visible frame range is [3, 4, 5, 6, 7]. Test getOnionSkinRange(currentFrame, before, after, totalFrames) at edges (frame 0, last frame) and with different before/after values. Tests in packages/core/src/engine/__tests__/onionskin.test.ts.
